## 2. 원시데이터 ACF, PACF, 단위근 검정
### 2-1. 차분 전 ACF/PACF

# total
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(total, main = 'acf(total) - 차분 전')
pacf(total, main = 'pacf(total) - 차분 전')

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# china
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(china, main = 'acf(china) - 차분 전')
pacf(china, main = 'pacf(china) - 차분 전')

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

### 2-2. 단위근 검정 (ADF, KPSS)
library(tseries)
## Warning: package 'tseries' was built under R version 4.5.3
## Registered S3 method overwritten by 'quantmod':
##   method            from
##   as.zoo.data.frame zoo
adf.test(total)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  total
## Dickey-Fuller = -0.99224, Lag order = 3, p-value = 0.9238
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf.test(china)
## Warning in adf.test(china): p-value greater than printed p-value
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  china
## Dickey-Fuller = -0.059149, Lag order = 3, p-value = 0.99
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(total)

## KPSS Level = 0.87767, Truncation lag parameter = 3, p-value = 0.01

## 3. 시계열 분해
### 3-1. 가법/승법 결정 (잔차 CV 비교)

# total
decomp_add <- decompose(total, type = "additive")
decomp_mul <- decompose(total, type = "multiplicative")
sd(decomp_add$random, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(total)
## [1] 0.03478541
sd(decomp_mul$random, na.rm= TRUE)
## [1] 0.03325622
# china
decomp_add <- decompose(china, type = "additive")
decomp_mul <- decompose(china, type = "multiplicative")
sd(decomp_add$random, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(china)
## [1] 0.07462387
sd(decomp_mul$random, na.rm = TRUE)
## [1] 0.1042733
### 3-2. 가법 분해 (decompose)
# total
de_total = decompose(total, type = c('additive')) 
plot(de_total)
title(main = 'total_분해')

# china
de_china = decompose(china, type = c('additive')) 
plot(de_china)
title(main = 'china_분해')

## 4. 차분 및 정상성 확인
### 4-1. total: 1차 차분 + 계절 차분

diff_season <- diff(diff(total), lag = 4)
adf.test(diff_season)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_season
## Dickey-Fuller = -3.0262, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.1807
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(diff_season)
## Warning in kpss.test(diff_season): p-value greater than printed p-value
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  diff_season
## KPSS Level = 0.065604, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(diff_season, main = "ACF(total) - 차분 후")
pacf(diff_season, main = "PACF(total) - 차분 후")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

### 4-2. china: 1차 차분 + 계절 차분
diff_season2 <- diff(diff(china), lag = 4)
diff_season3 <- diff(diff_season2)
adf.test(diff_season2)
## Warning in adf.test(diff_season2): p-value smaller than printed p-value
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_season2
## Dickey-Fuller = -4.564, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.01
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
adf.test(diff_season3)
## 
##  Augmented Dickey-Fuller Test
## 
## data:  diff_season3
## Dickey-Fuller = -3.0333, Lag order = 2, p-value = 0.1788
## alternative hypothesis: stationary
kpss.test(diff_season3)
## Warning in kpss.test(diff_season3): p-value greater than printed p-value
## 
##  KPSS Test for Level Stationarity
## 
## data:  diff_season3
## KPSS Level = 0.069268, Truncation lag parameter = 2, p-value = 0.1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(diff_season2, main = "ACF2(china) - 차분 후")
pacf(diff_season2, main = "PACF2(china) - 차분 후")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

## 5. 모형 결정
### 5-1. 후보 모형 적합 및 모수 유의성 검정
auto.arima(total)
## Series: total 
## ARIMA(0,1,0)(1,1,0)[4] 
## 
## Coefficients:
##          sar1
##       -0.4181
## s.e.   0.2000
## 
## sigma^2 = 3.209e+09:  log likelihood = -333.69
## AIC=671.38   AICc=671.88   BIC=673.97
auto.arima(china)
## Series: china 
## ARIMA(1,2,0) 
## 
## Coefficients:
##           ar1
##       -0.7769
## s.e.   0.1279
## 
## sigma^2 = 799226192:  log likelihood = -350.01
## AIC=704.02   AICc=704.46   BIC=706.82
total_1 <- arima(total, order=c(0,1,1), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1), period=4))
coeftest(total_1)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##      Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)
## ma1  -0.30372    0.19896 -1.5265   0.1269
## sma1 -0.26936    0.20289 -1.3276   0.1843
total_2 <- arima(total, order=c(0,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1), period=4))

china_1 <- arima(china, order=c(0,1,1), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=4))
coeftest(china_1)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##     Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)
## ma1  0.14503    0.18989  0.7637    0.445
china_2 <- arima(china, order=c(0,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=4))

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

### 8-5. 후보 모형 적합 및 선택
share_1 <- arima(share, order = c(0,1,1), seasonal = list(order = c(1,1,1), period = 4))
coeftest(share_1)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##      Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)
## ma1   0.20781    0.20697  1.0040   0.3154
## sar1 -0.33624    0.31802 -1.0573   0.2904
## sma1 -0.43467    0.31244 -1.3912   0.1642
share_2 <- arima(share, order = c(0,1,1), seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,1), period = 4))
share_3 <- arima(share, order=c(1,1,0), seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,1), period=4))

AIC(share_1, share_2,share_3)
##         df       AIC
## share_1  4 -118.0270
## share_2  3 -119.1646
## share_3  3 -118.9583
BIC(share_1, share_2, share_3)
##         df       BIC
## share_1  4 -112.8437
## share_2  3 -115.2771
## share_3  3 -115.0708
auto.arima(share)
## Series: share 
## ARIMA(0,1,0) 
## 
## sigma^2 = 0.0005624:  log likelihood = 72
## AIC=-142.01   AICc=-141.87   BIC=-140.57
coeftest(share_3)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##      Estimate Std. Error z value  Pr(>|z|)    
## ar1   0.17642    0.19027  0.9272 0.3538189    
## sma1 -0.68243    0.19333 -3.5299 0.0004158 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
share_fit <- arima(share, order = c(0,1,0), seasonal = list(order = c(0,1,1), period = 4))
coeftest(share_fit)
## 
## z test of coefficients:
## 
##      Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|)    
## sma1 -0.65493    0.19233 -3.4053 0.000661 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
### 8-6. 적합값 시각화

fitted(share_fit)[1:8]
## [1] 0.13369371 0.14988868 0.14083868 0.12712727 0.07363837 0.08427009 0.05340252
## [8] 0.06329876
ylim_range <- range(share, fitted(share_fit))
plot(share, col="black", main="share 적합값", ylab="점유율")
lines(fitted(share_fit), col="green")
legend("topleft", legend=c("실제값","적합값"), col=c("black","green"), lty=1)

### 8-7. 잔차 진단

ts.plot(resid(share_fit))
abline(h = 0)

qqnorm(resid(share_fit))
qqline(resid(share_fit))

LjungBox(share_fit)
##  lags statistic df   p-value
##     5  4.161155  5 0.5264548
##    10  6.779457 10 0.7460886
##    15 10.726839 15 0.7717070
##    20 18.248501 20 0.5710422
##    25 18.749154 25 0.8089867
##    30 18.834535 30 0.9434046
acf2(resid(share_fit))

##      [,1]  [,2]  [,3]  [,4] [,5]  [,6]  [,7] [,8] [,9]
## ACF  0.04 -0.17 -0.19 -0.15 0.13 -0.04  0.01 0.02 0.17
## PACF 0.04 -0.17 -0.19 -0.18 0.08 -0.14 -0.01 0.00 0.20
res_share <- residuals(share_fit)
std_share <- (res_share - mean(res_share)) / sd(res_share)
outlier_idx <- which(abs(std_share) > 2.5)
time(std_share)[outlier_idx]
## [1] 2020.25
### 8-8. 예측 및 임계점 돌파 시점
p_share <- forecast(share_fit, h=12)

plot(share, main="중국 직구 점유율 예측",
     ylab="점유율", xlim=c(2014,2029), ylim=c(0,1))
lines(ts(p_share$mean, start=c(2022,1), frequency=4), col="blue")
lines(ts(p_share$upper[,1], start=c(2022,1), frequency=4), col="blue", lty=2)
lines(ts(p_share$lower[,1], start=c(2022,1), frequency=4), col="blue", lty=2)
abline(h=0.6, col="red", lty=2)

time(p_share$mean)[which(p_share$mean >= 0.6)[1]]
## [1] NA
# 70% 임계점 최초 돌파 시점
time(p_share$mean)[which(p_share$mean >= 0.6)[1]]
## [1] NA
